platform.label: Platform terms
platform.title: Website and customer-account terms
platform.intro: The rules for using the SK Event Hire website, customer account, quotations and online services.
platform.summary: Use the platform lawfully, keep account access secure and confirm that information you submit is accurate.

sections.title: Using the platform
sections.content: You may browse publicly available content and use account features for genuine event-hire enquiries and bookings. Automated scraping, interference, impersonation and unlawful use are prohibited.

sections.title: Account responsibility
sections.content: Keep verification codes and account access private. Tell us promptly if you believe an account or booking has been accessed without permission.

sections.title: Website information
sections.content: Images, availability, dimensions and guide content help with planning but do not replace the final accepted quotation and product-specific instructions.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.content: Site copy, branding, photography and interface elements remain protected. They may not be reproduced commercially without written permission.

rental.label: Rental terms
rental.title: Rental terms and responsibilities
rental.intro: The core conditions for quotations, confirmed bookings, hire periods, safe use and return.
rental.summary: Products are reserved after confirmation and required payment. Keep every item safe and return it on time in the agreed condition.

sections.title: Quote and confirmation
sections.content: A product is not reserved until availability is checked, the current quotation is accepted and the required payment is received. The accepted quotation records dates, quantities, pricing and special conditions.

sections.title: Hire period
sections.content: The hire starts and ends at the times shown in the booking. An extension is valid only after stock, transport and charges are confirmed in writing.

sections.title: Care and permitted use
sections.content: Use products only for their intended event purpose. Protect them from unsafe weather, theft, fire, misuse, unauthorised movement and prohibited attachments.

sections.title: Return condition
sections.content: Return every product, cover, component and accessory grouped and accessible. Fair wear is allowed; excess cleaning, missing components and avoidable damage are assessed separately.

product.label: Product hire terms
product.title: Product condition, selection and substitution
product.intro: Specific expectations for hired furniture, marquees, tableware, linen, lighting and accessories.
product.summary: Check product measurements, intended use and quantities before acceptance. Minor batch and screen-colour variation can occur.

sections.title: Product selection
sections.content: The customer must review measurements, capacity, finish, quantity and venue suitability. Our team can advise, but venue approval and final selection remain part of the confirmed order.

sections.title: Images and finishes
sections.content: Photography is representative. Timber, fabric, metal and batch finishes may vary slightly, and screens do not reproduce colour exactly.

sections.title: Availability and alternatives
sections.content: Online availability is indicative. If an item becomes unavailable, we will communicate a suitable alternative; a material substitution is not made to a confirmed order without approval.

sections.title: Safety instructions
sections.content: Weight, anchoring, weather, electrical and assembly instructions must be followed. Only authorised crew may alter installed structures or powered equipment.

payment.label: Payment terms
payment.title: Deposits, balances and refunds
payment.intro: How quotations, GST, deposits, balances, payment methods and approved refunds are handled.
payment.summary: The invoice shows what is due and when. A booking is not confirmed until the required payment has cleared.

sections.title: Prices and GST
sections.content: Prices are in Australian dollars and include GST unless the quotation clearly states otherwise. Delivery, labour, late access and sourced items are itemised where applicable.

sections.title: Deposit and balance
sections.content: The deposit confirms the booking once stock is rechecked. The remaining balance must be received by the invoice due date and before dispatch.

sections.title: Payment security
sections.content: PayID, approved bank transfer and approved cash payment may be available. Customers must use the supplied booking reference, and cash is only recorded as paid after an authorised receipt is issued.

sections.title: Refunds and charge review
sections.content: Approved refunds return to the original payment source after cancellation, damage, missing items and non-refundable commitments are finalised.

cancellation.label: Changes & cancellations
cancellation.title: Changes, cancellations and rescheduling
cancellation.intro: How date, quantity, venue and order changes are reviewed, including weather-related requests.
cancellation.summary: Tell us early. Every change remains a request until stock, crew, suppliers, logistics and price are revalidated.

sections.title: Order changes
sections.content: Quantity, product, time, address and access changes may alter availability, labour, transport and price. The revised quotation controls once accepted.

sections.title: Cancellation timing
sections.content: Charges reflect notice, warehouse preparation, reserved logistics, custom items and non-refundable supplier commitments. Your quotation states the applicable schedule.

sections.title: Weather and venue decisions
sections.content: Weather does not automatically cancel a booking. Contact us early to review relocation, walling, anchoring, flooring, heating or an available date change.

sections.title: Refund timing
sections.content: Any approved balance is calculated after committed charges and normally returned to the original payment source.

damage.label: Damage, loss & bond
damage.title: Damage, loss, cleaning and security amounts
damage.intro: The assessment process for damaged, excessively soiled, altered, stolen or missing hire products.
damage.summary: Report incidents promptly and keep evidence. Charges are based on reasonable cleaning, repair or replacement cost.

sections.title: Security amount or bond
sections.content: A refundable security amount may be required based on order value, product type, venue and risk. It is not an insurance policy or automatic limit on responsibility.

sections.title: Damage reporting
sections.content: Stop using unsafe equipment and contact us promptly. Provide photos, timing and circumstances so the item can be isolated and assessed.

sections.title: Missing products
sections.content: Missing items and accessories remain on hire until returned or resolved. Search the venue and contact suppliers immediately; replacement and extended-hire costs may apply.

sections.title: Evidence and review
sections.content: Condition records, photographs, repair quotations and replacement cost may support an assessment. You can request the evidence and a fair review.

delivery.label: Delivery & collection
delivery.title: Delivery, setup, collection and customer return
delivery.intro: Access, timing, crew, setup boundaries, waiting time and return responsibilities.
delivery.summary: Provide accurate access details and an authorised contact. Keep the site safe and products ready at the agreed time.

sections.title: Access and delivery window
sections.content: Confirm parking, gates, stairs, lifts, surfaces, doorway sizes, venue restrictions and an on-site contact. Time windows depend on route and crew planning.

sections.title: Setup boundaries
sections.content: Only setup work listed in the accepted quotation is included. Venue preparation, utilities and supplier coordination remain the customer’s responsibility unless contracted.

sections.title: Collection
sections.content: Keep all items dry, grouped, unobstructed and accessible. Waiting, failed collection or extra crew charges may apply if the agreed collection cannot proceed.

sections.title: Customer pickup and return
sections.content: Approved pickups require an appointment, photo identification, suitable enclosed transport and load restraint. Late returns require written approval.

privacy.label: Privacy policy
privacy.title: Privacy and personal information
privacy.intro: What we collect, why we use it, when it is shared and the choices available to you.
privacy.summary: We use information to quote, deliver, support, prevent fraud and meet legal obligations—not to sell personal information.

sections.title: Information collected
sections.content: We may collect contact, account, event, venue, quotation, payment-reference, delivery, condition, support and website-use information.

sections.title: Purpose and lawful use
sections.content: Information supports enquiries, bookings, logistics, payments, safety, customer care, records, fraud prevention and legally required reporting.

sections.title: Service providers and disclosure
sections.content: Approved payment, hosting, communication, delivery, professional and legal providers receive only the information reasonably needed for their role.

sections.title: Access, correction and retention
sections.content: Request access or correction through customer care. Deletion and export requests are handled where law and required business-record periods allow.

cookies.label: Cookie notice
cookies.title: Cookie and tracking preferences
cookies.intro: Essential website storage, optional analytics and how to change your preference.
cookies.summary: Essential cookies stay on for security and core functions. Optional analytics remain under your control.

sections.title: Essential storage
sections.content: Session, security, quotation and preference storage supports login, navigation, basket and abuse prevention.

sections.title: Optional analytics
sections.content: When enabled, aggregated usage information helps identify performance and usability problems.

sections.title: Retention
sections.content: Cookie duration depends on purpose, from the current session to a maximum period disclosed by the provider.

sections.title: Changing your choice
sections.content: You can disable optional cookies below. Browser controls may also remove stored data, but blocking essentials can affect account and quotation features.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: Our commitment to understandable content, keyboard access, readable layouts and practical support.
accessibility.summary: Tell us if a page, document or process is difficult to use. We will provide reasonable assistance or an alternative format.

sections.title: Design approach
sections.content: We aim for semantic structure, visible focus, sufficient contrast, responsive layouts and text that remains readable when enlarged.

sections.title: Keyboard and assistive technology
sections.content: Core navigation, forms, accordions and account tasks are designed for keyboard and common assistive-technology use.

sections.title: Alternative formats
sections.content: Contact us for a policy, invoice, quotation or instruction in a more accessible format.

sections.title: Feedback
sections.content: Include the page, device and difficulty encountered. Accessibility requests are prioritised by customer care.

items.question: When is my hire equipment reserved?
items.answer: Products are reserved only after availability is rechecked, the current quotation is accepted and the required deposit is received. A draft quote or enquiry does not reserve stock.

items.question: How long is the standard hire period?
items.answer: The exact start and return times appear on your quotation. Extensions require written approval because later bookings, warehouse preparation and transport schedules may be affected.

items.question: Can I change quantities after booking?
items.answer: Yes. Submit the requested item and quantity change before the warehouse cut-off. Every change remains subject to stock, labour, transport and revised-price confirmation.

items.question: Is there a minimum hire order?
items.answer: Minimum product or service values may apply depending on collection, delivery zone, crew requirements and event date. The quotation shows any minimum clearly.

items.question: How much deposit is required?
items.answer: The required deposit is shown on the quotation and depends on order value, sourced products and services. Paying it confirms the booking only while the quotation remains valid.

items.question: When is the remaining balance due?
items.answer: The balance due date appears on your invoice and is normally before warehouse dispatch. Late payment can delay preparation or release of equipment.

items.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept PayID, approved bank transfer and approved cash payments. Always use the booking reference supplied by SK Event Hire so the payment can be matched correctly.

items.question: Are prices inclusive of GST?
items.answer: Website and quotation prices are in Australian dollars and include GST unless a line is clearly marked otherwise.

items.question: What happens if an item is damaged?
items.answer: Tell us as soon as possible and stop using anything unsafe. We record the condition, review dispatch and return evidence, and provide an itemised repair, specialist-cleaning or replacement assessment.

items.question: What if a product is missing at collection?
items.answer: Check the venue, packing area and supplier zones immediately. Missing items are recorded during collection and may be charged at reasonable replacement cost if they are not recovered.

items.question: How are damage charges decided?
items.answer: Charges are based on evidence, product age, repairability, specialist labour, cleaning and reasonable replacement cost. You may request the supporting evidence and a review.

items.question: Is a bond or security amount required?
items.answer: Some orders require a refundable bond or security amount based on value, venue, risk and product type. Any amount and release conditions are disclosed before acceptance.

items.question: What counts as excessive cleaning?
items.answer: Wax, paint, tape residue, food contamination, mud, smoke damage or other treatment beyond normal commercial cleaning may attract an itemised specialist-cleaning charge.

items.question: What information is needed for delivery?
items.answer: Provide the full address, parking or loading area, height restrictions, stairs, lift access, surface conditions, venue contact and required setup completion time.

items.question: Is setup included in delivery?
items.answer: Only setup work listed in the accepted quotation is included. Product placement, styling, venue work and pack-down outside that scope remain the customer’s responsibility.

items.question: Can I collect and return products myself?
items.answer: Eligible items may be collected by appointment in a suitable enclosed vehicle. Photo identification, safe restraints and compliance with warehouse instructions are required.

items.question: What happens if collection is delayed?
items.answer: Keep products secure, dry and accessible. Waiting time, additional crew, failed collection or extended-hire charges may apply when the agreed collection cannot proceed.

items.question: Are website products guaranteed to be available?
items.answer: No. Website availability is indicative until your dates, quantities, venue and logistics are checked and the booking is confirmed.

items.question: Can product colours or finishes vary?
items.answer: Minor variations can occur between batches, natural materials and screen displays. Material colour or finish requirements should be confirmed on the quotation.

items.question: Will you substitute an unavailable product?
items.answer: We may recommend a suitable alternative, but nothing is substituted in a confirmed order without communicating the material change and obtaining approval where required.

items.question: Can indoor products be used outside?
items.answer: Only when explicitly approved and protected from rain, wind, mud, heat and uneven surfaces. Products must be moved to safety when conditions change.

items.question: What happens if bad weather is forecast?
items.answer: Contact us early. Weather does not automatically cancel a booking, but we can review relocation, walling, anchoring, flooring, heating or an approved date change.

items.question: Can I change the event date?
items.answer: A date change is a request until products, crew, delivery and sourced items are rechecked. Price differences and committed supplier costs may apply.

items.question: How do cancellation charges work?
items.answer: Charges depend on notice, supplier commitments, custom or sourced items, warehouse preparation and reserved logistics. The current cancellation policy and accepted quotation control the assessment.

items.question: How are approved refunds paid?
items.answer: Approved refunds are normally returned to the original payment source after final charges and non-refundable items are confirmed.

items.question: What information does SK Event Hire keep?
items.answer: We retain contact, event, venue, quotation, payment-reference, delivery, condition and support records needed to provide the service and meet legal obligations.

items.question: Can I access or correct my information?
items.answer: Yes. Contact customer care to request access or correction. Deletion and export requests are handled where applicable law and required record-retention periods allow.

items.question: Where can I find invoices and booking documents?
items.answer: Sign in to the customer account and open Payments & Documents. The current quotation, invoices, receipts and rental agreement remain connected to the booking.

items.question: How quickly will support reply?
items.answer: Standard enquiries are normally reviewed within one business day. Event-day safety or delivery concerns should use the phone details supplied with the confirmed booking.

completeFaqItems.q: Where can I read the complete {topic} rules?
completeFaqItems.a: Open Terms & Policies from the footer and select the matching category.

completeFaqItems.q: What details should I provide about {topic}?
completeFaqItems.a: Include your booking or quotation reference, event date, venue, the affected product or service, and clear supporting details so the team can review the correct record.
Use the Contact page or customer support form.

completeFaqItems.q: Will a {topic} request change my confirmed booking automatically?
completeFaqItems.a: No. A request does not alter the confirmed order until availability and adjustments are approved and re-issued by the event team.
